eras.era_zh: 新石器时代：乳品与凝乳的起源

facts.zh: 对近东与东南欧 2200 余件新石器时代陶器的脂质残留分析显示，安纳托利亚西北部（马尔马拉海周边）在公元前 7 千纪已经加工乳品。这类证据只能说明「用奶」，分不出是鲜奶、酸奶还是奶酪。
facts.en: Lipid-residue analysis of more than 2,200 Neolithic pots from the Near East and south-eastern Europe shows that milk was being processed in north-western Anatolia (around the Sea of Marmara) in the 7th millennium BC. Such residues show milk use, not which product was made.
facts.year: 公元前 7 千纪（约前 6500 年）
facts.kind: 陶器脂质残留（化学证据）

sources.title: Evershed et al. 2008, Earliest date for milk use in the Near East and southeastern Europe linked to cattle herding, Nature 455:528–531

facts.note: nature.com 本次未能打开，数字按论文摘要通行转述；前 6500 年为常见概括，摘要原文写「7th millennium BC」。

facts.zh: 撒哈拉中部利比亚阿卡库斯山区（Takarkori 岩厦）出土陶器中检出乳脂，表明公元前 5 千纪「绿色撒哈拉」时期的牧民已在加工奶。当地岩画里有牛群与挤奶的场面，但岩画本身很难准确断代，所以年代依据是陶器残留。
facts.en: Milk fat in pottery from the Takarkori rock shelter in Libya's Acacus Mountains shows herders in the then-green Sahara processing milk in the 5th millennium BC. Rock art in the region shows cattle and milking, but the paintings are hard to date, so the date rests on the pottery residues.
facts.year: 公元前 5 千纪（约前 5200 年）
facts.kind: 陶器脂质残留 + 岩画（图像证据，难断代）

sources.title: Dunne et al. 2012, First dairying in green Saharan Africa in the fifth millennium BC, Nature 486:390–394

facts.zh: 波兰中北部库亚维亚（Kuyavia）地区线纹陶文化（LBK）遗址出土的穿孔陶滤器，内壁检出大量乳脂。研究者认为它们是用来把富含脂肪的凝乳和含乳糖的乳清分开的，这是欧洲制作奶酪最早的直接化学证据。
facts.en: Perforated pottery sieves from Linear Pottery (LBK) sites in Kuyavia, north-central Poland, contain abundant milk fat. The authors read them as strainers for separating fatty curds from lactose-rich whey, the earliest direct chemical evidence of cheese making in Europe.
facts.year: 公元前 6 千纪（媒体通稿称约 7500 年前）
facts.num: 34 件穿孔陶器、50 个样品
facts.alt: 具体年代区间各处转述不一：通稿「约 7500 年前」≈ 前 5500 年；也常见「约前 5200–4900 年」的写法。

sources.title: Salque et al. 2013, Earliest evidence for cheese making in the sixth millennium BC in northern Europe, Nature 493:522–525
Live Science: Holy Cow! First Cheesemakers Date Back 7,500 Years (2012-12-12)

facts.note: Nature 摘要只写「sixth millennium BC」；精确区间未能从原文核到，页面建议写「约 7000–7500 年前」。

facts.zh: 克罗地亚达尔马提亚沿岸 Pokrovnik、Danilo Bitinj 两处新石器遗址的陶器残留显示：约公元前 5700 年最早的压印纹陶里已有奶；约公元前 5200 年，带足的 rhyton 器里检出奶酪、滤器里检出发酵乳品，这是地中海地区已知最早的奶酪证据。
facts.en: Pottery residues from the Neolithic sites of Pokrovnik and Danilo Bitinj on Croatia's Dalmatian coast show milk in the earliest Impressed Ware by about 5700 BC, and by about 5200 BC cheese in footed rhyta and fermented dairy in sieves, the earliest cheese evidence known from the Mediterranean.
facts.year: 约公元前 5200 年（7200 年前）；奶最早约前 5700 年
facts.kind: 陶器脂质残留（单体脂肪酸 δ13C）

sources.title: McClure et al. 2018, Fatty acid specific δ13C values reveal earliest Mediterranean cheese production 7,200 years ago, PLOS ONE 13(9): e0202807

facts.note: 已打开 PLOS 页核对：2018-09-05 发表，作者 McClure, Magill, Podrug 等。

facts.zh: 早期农人成年后大多不能消化乳糖。把奶做成奶酪或酸奶，大部分乳糖会随乳清排出或被发酵掉，所以研究者推测：奶酪先于「成年人喝奶」的能力出现，是早期农人吃得下奶的办法。
facts.en: Most early farmers could not digest lactose as adults. Turning milk into cheese or yoghurt removes most lactose with the whey or by fermentation, so researchers suggest cheese came before adult milk-drinking and was how early farmers could use milk at all.
facts.kind: 推论（遗传学 + 残留证据）

sources.title: Salque et al. 2013, Nature 493:522–525
Live Science (2012) summary

facts.zh: 关于凝乳如何被发现，流传最广的是一个传说：古代旅人用羊或小牛的胃袋装奶赶路，胃壁里的凝乳酶加上体温和颠簸，奶就变成了凝块和乳清。这一说法没有考古证据，属于推测。另一种看法是，人们最早做的是靠乳酸菌自然变酸凝固的鲜奶酪，用凝乳酶是后来的事。
facts.en: The best-known story of how curd was discovered is a legend: a traveller carried milk in a sheep's or calf's stomach, and the rennet in its lining, with warmth and jolting, split the milk into curds and whey. There is no archaeological evidence for it. Another view holds that the first cheeses were fresh cheeses set by souring alone, with rennet coming later.
facts.alt: 说法一：胃袋储奶→偶然酶凝（传说）。说法二：先有自然酸凝的鲜奶酪，酶凝晚出（学界推测）。

sources.title: Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture: A History of Cheese and Its Place in Western Civilization (Chelsea Green, 2012)

facts.note: 页面上要明确标「传说」。

cheeses.origin: 近东 / 欧洲早期农人
cheeses.what_zh: 奶自然变酸后凝结，用陶滤器沥去乳清，得到含乳糖很少的软凝乳，现做现吃或加盐延长存放。
cheeses.what_en: Milk soured naturally, drained through pottery sieves into a soft low-lactose curd, eaten fresh or salted to keep.

eras.era_zh: 青铜时代：埃及、两河、新疆

facts.zh: 伊拉克乌拜德土丘（Tell al-Ubaid）宁胡尔萨格女神庙出土的镶嵌饰带（约公元前 2500 年），描绘了挤奶和在大罐里处理奶的场面，是两河流域乳品加工最著名的图像。
facts.en: An inlaid frieze from the temple of Ninhursag at Tell al-Ubaid, Iraq (c. 2500 BC), shows milking and milk being worked in large jars, the best-known Mesopotamian image of dairying.

sources.title: Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 2

facts.note: 饰带现藏巴格达伊拉克博物馆；饰带画面是否在「做奶酪」还是做黄油存在解读差异。

facts.zh: 乌尔第三王朝（约公元前 2100–2000 年）的苏美尔楔形文字账目中，奶酪（苏美尔语 ga-àr）与黄油一起作为神庙收支物资登记，有成批的数量记录。
facts.en: Cuneiform accounts of the Ur III period (c. 2100–2000 BC) list cheese (Sumerian ga-àr) alongside butter as temple income and outgoings, often in bulk quantities.

sources.title: Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 2

facts.zh: 埃及萨卡拉的孟菲斯市长 Ptahmes 墓（第十九王朝，约公元前 13 世纪）出土的破罐中，有一团发白的固态物，蛋白质组学分析认定是用牛奶和绵羊/山羊奶混合做成的奶酪，被称为已知最古老的固态奶酪残留。该墓 1885 年首次发掘后被沙掩埋，2010 年重新找到。
facts.en: Broken jars in the Saqqara tomb of Ptahmes, mayor of Memphis (19th Dynasty, 13th century BC), held a whitish solid mass that proteomic analysis identified as cheese made from cow's milk mixed with sheep or goat milk, described as the oldest solid cheese residue known. The tomb, first dug in 1885, was lost to the sand and found again in 2010.
facts.year: 约公元前 1200 年代（研究发表于 2018 年）
facts.kind: 实物残留 + 蛋白质组学

sources.title: Greco et al. 2018, Proteomic Analyses on an Ancient Egyptian Cheese and Biomolecular Evidence of Brucellosis, Analytical Chemistry, doi:10.1021/acs.analchem.8b02535
Phys.org: World's oldest cheese found in Egyptian tomb (2018-08)

facts.zh: 同一份 Ptahmes 墓奶酪样品中还检出布鲁氏菌（Brucella melitensis）的肽段。布鲁氏菌病常由未经消毒的奶制品传播；若得到确认，这将是该病最早的生物分子证据，但作者称这仍是初步结果。
facts.en: The Ptahmes sample also yielded peptides of Brucella melitensis. Brucellosis is often spread through unpasteurised dairy; if confirmed, this would be the earliest biomolecular evidence of the disease, though the authors call it preliminary.

sources.title: Greco et al. 2018, Analytical Chemistry
Phys.org (2018)

facts.zh: 新疆罗布泊附近的小河墓地，木乃伊颈部和胸前随葬着块状奶酪。2014 年的蛋白质组学研究认为它是用乳酸菌与酵母（类似开菲尔粒）发酵而成，不用凝乳酶，最早样品约公元前 1615 年。
facts.en: At the Xiaohe cemetery near Lop Nur in Xinjiang, lumps of cheese were buried on the necks and chests of mummies. A 2014 proteomic study found it was set by lactic bacteria and yeasts, like kefir grains, without rennet; the oldest sample dates to about 1615 BC.
facts.year: 约公元前 1615 年（研究发表于 2014 年）

sources.title: Yang et al. 2014, Proteomics evidence for kefir dairy in Early Bronze Age China, Journal of Archaeological Science 45:178–186, doi:10.1016/j.jas.2014.02.005
Max Planck Society: The mummy cheese

facts.note: 「前 1615 年」是原论文摘要的写法（凭记忆，ADS 页未显示摘要）；MPG 新闻稿只写「约 4000 年的木乃伊」。

facts.zh: 2024 年中国科学院古脊椎所付巧妹团队在《Cell》发表小河奶酪的古 DNA 研究：三份样品里重建出开菲尔乳杆菌（Lactobacillus kefiranofaciens）和库德里阿兹威毕赤酵母的基因组，牛奶和山羊奶分批使用、不相混合。古菌株位于今天内陆东亚（含西藏）菌株分支的根部。
facts.en: In 2024 Fu Qiaomei's team at the Chinese Academy of Sciences published ancient DNA from three Xiaohe cheese samples in Cell, reconstructing genomes of Lactobacillus kefiranofaciens and the yeast Pichia kudriavzevii. Cow and goat milk were used in separate batches, not mixed. The ancient strains sit at the base of the branch of today's inland East Asian (including Tibetan) strains.

sources.title: Liu et al. 2024, Bronze Age cheese reveals human-Lactobacillus interactions over evolutionary history, Cell, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2024.08.008
AZoLifeSciences: Metagenomic Study Reveals the Most Ancient Dairy Remains Known to Date (2024-09-26)
The Microbiologist: World's oldest cheese found with ancient mummies reveals origins of kefir

facts.note: 媒体对样品年代写 3500 或 3600 年不一；奶源一处报道只写山羊，另一处写牛与山羊分批，取后者需核原文。

cheeses.origin: 埃及萨卡拉，约前 13 世纪
cheeses.what_zh: 牛奶与绵羊/山羊奶混合制成的固态奶酪，盛在陶罐里随葬，罐口覆麻布。
cheeses.what_en: A solid cheese of mixed cow and sheep or goat milk, buried in a jar covered with linen.

cheeses.origin: 新疆小河墓地，约前 1600 年
cheeses.what_zh: 用乳酸菌与酵母共生的「开菲尔粒」发酵凝固，不用凝乳酶，做成小块放在死者颈部和胸前。
cheeses.what_en: Set by a kefir-like culture of lactic bacteria and yeasts, no rennet, placed in lumps on the necks and chests of the dead.

facts.zh: 《奥德赛》第九卷里，独眼巨人波吕斐摩斯挤完绵羊和山羊的奶，把一半白奶凝结起来，收进柳条编的筐里存放，另一半盛在器皿里留着晚饭喝。这是西方文学里最早的做奶酪场景。
facts.en: In Book 9 of the Odyssey the Cyclops Polyphemus milks his ewes and goats, curdles half the white milk and lays it away in wicker baskets, and keeps the other half in vessels to drink with his supper, the earliest cheese-making scene in Western literature.
facts.year: 约公元前 8 世纪（史诗成书年代）

sources.title: Homer, Odyssey 9.244–249 (A. T. Murray tr., Perseus Digital Library)

facts.zh: 罗马学者瓦罗在《论农业》（公元前 37 年）里比较三种奶酪：牛奶酪最有营养但最难消化，绵羊奶酪次之，山羊奶酪营养最少而最易消化；他还认为野兔和小山羊的凝乳酶比羔羊的好。
facts.en: Varro's On Agriculture (37 BC) ranks cheeses: cow's milk cheese is the most nourishing and hardest to digest, sheep's next, goat's the least nourishing and easiest to digest. He also rates the rennet of hare and kid above that of lamb.

sources.title: Varro, De re rustica 2.11 (LacusCurtius)

facts.note: 内容凭对原典的记忆，LacusCurtius 本次打不开，需对照 2.11.3–4 原文。

facts.zh: 科卢梅拉《论农业》第七卷第八章（约公元 60–65 年）记载了完整的奶酪工艺：用羔羊或小山羊的凝乳酶使奶凝结，也可用野蓟花、红花籽或无花果树汁；凝块放进筐或模具沥乳清，压上重物，撒盐晾干。他说压得紧实、充分干燥的奶酪「甚至可以运过海去」。
facts.en: Columella's On Agriculture, Book 7, chapter 8 (c. AD 60–65) sets out the whole process: milk is set with the rennet of a lamb or kid, or with wild thistle flowers, safflower seed or fig sap; the curd drains in baskets or moulds, is pressed under weights, salted and dried. Cheese made firm and dry this way, he says, can even be shipped overseas.

sources.title: Columella, De re rustica 7.8 (Latin text, The Latin Library)

facts.zh: 科卢梅拉还写了两种变化：一种是「手压奶酪」，凝块切开后浇热水、用手捏成形；另一种是把奶酪挂起来用苹果木或麦秆烟熏上色。
facts.en: Columella also describes 'hand-pressed' cheese, where the curd is cut, scalded with hot water and shaped by hand, and cheese hung up to be coloured with smoke from apple wood or straw.

sources.title: Columella, De re rustica 7.8 (Latin text, The Latin Library)

facts.note: 「手压」「烟熏」细节凭记忆，原文页已打开但只核了凝乳酶与「运过海」两句。

facts.zh: 老普林尼《自然史》第十一卷（公元 77 年）列举罗马人心中的名奶酪：最受推崇的来自高卢尼姆（Nemausus）一带的 Lesura 与 Gabalis 村落，但只宜趁鲜吃；阿尔卑斯山、亚平宁山各有名产；伊特鲁里亚与利古里亚交界的卢纳（Luna）奶酪以个头大著称，一只可重达千磅；海外则以小亚细亚比提尼亚的最好。
facts.en: Pliny the Elder's Natural History, Book 11 (AD 77), lists the cheeses Rome prized most: those from the Nemausus (Nîmes) province, from the villages of Lesura and Gabalis, though only when fresh; cheeses of the Alps and Apennines; the huge cheeses of Luna on the Etruscan–Ligurian border, up to a thousand pounds each; and, overseas, the cheese of Bithynia.
facts.num: 卢纳奶酪单只重达 1000 罗马磅（约 327 公斤）

sources.title: Pliny the Elder, Natural History 11.97 (Bostock & Riley tr., Perseus Digital Library)

facts.note: Lesura 一般认作今洛泽尔（Lozère），Gabalis 即热沃当（Gévaudan），今 Roquefort 以东一带；1 罗马磅≈327 克。

facts.zh: 奶酪是罗马士兵的日常口粮之一。据《罗马帝王纪·哈德良传》，哈德良皇帝在军营里与士兵同吃营中伙食，即腌肉、奶酪和掺水的酸酒（posca）。
facts.en: Cheese was a staple of the Roman soldier's diet. The Historia Augusta's life of Hadrian says the emperor gladly ate camp food in the open with his troops: bacon, cheese and posca, a sour wine-and-water drink.
facts.year: 公元 2 世纪（哈德良在位 117–138；文献成书约 4 世纪末）

sources.title: Historia Augusta, Life of Hadrian 10.2 (LacusCurtius)
R. W. Davies, The Roman Military Diet, Britannia 2 (1971), cited in Gutteridge, UCSB Undergraduate Journal of History

facts.note: 拉丁原句「larido caseo et posca」凭记忆；网上流传的「每名军团兵每天约 27 克奶酪」之类具体配给量未找到可靠出处，不建议上页面。

cheeses.origin: 意大利伊特鲁里亚与利古里亚交界的卢纳
cheeses.what_zh: 普林尼记载的巨型奶酪，一只重达千磅；诗人马提亚尔（《隽语》13.30）说它印着卢纳城的月亮图样，够仆人吃一千顿午饭。
cheeses.what_en: The giant cheese Pliny describes, up to a thousand pounds; the poet Martial (Epigrams 13.30) says it was stamped with the moon of Luna and would feed your slaves a thousand lunches.

cheeses.origin: 高卢南部，今法国洛泽尔—热沃当
cheeses.what_zh: 罗马市场上评价最高的高卢奶酪，宜鲜食；常被视作今天中央高原奶酪传统的前身。
cheeses.what_en: The Gaulish cheese most praised in Rome, best eaten fresh; often seen as a forerunner of the Massif Central cheese tradition.

cheeses.name_zh: 罗马绵羊奶酪（Pecorino Romano 的前身之说）
cheeses.name_en: Roman sheep's cheese (claimed ancestor of Pecorino Romano)
cheeses.what_zh: 硬质咸味绵羊奶酪；今天的 Pecorino Romano 自称延续了这一传统，属于品牌叙事，没有连续的实物证据。
cheeses.what_en: A hard, salty sheep's cheese; today's Pecorino Romano claims to continue it, a heritage story rather than a documented line.

eras.era_zh: 中世纪：修道院、特许状与集市

facts.zh: 罗马帝国瓦解后，欧洲的奶酪技术很大程度上靠修道院和庄园延续。若干法国名奶酪有修院出身的记载，例如北部的 Maroilles 与马鲁瓦耶修道院（10 世纪）、阿尔萨斯的 Munster 与孟斯特河谷的本笃会修士（7 世纪起）。常听到的「洗皮奶酪是修士发明的」是概括性说法：个别品种有修院渊源可查，但并非所有洗皮奶酪都出自修士。
facts.en: After Rome fell, European cheese know-how was carried largely by monasteries and manors. Several French cheeses have recorded monastic roots, such as Maroilles and the abbey of Maroilles (10th century) and Munster with the Benedictines of the Munster valley in Alsace (from the 7th century). The popular claim that monks invented washed-rind cheese is a generalisation: some washed rinds do have monastic origins, but not all.
facts.kind: 修院文书 + 后世传统叙述
facts.alt: 说法一：洗皮奶酪源于修院（斋期以奶酪代肉、修士用盐水擦洗）。说法二：洗皮工艺在农家与山区同样普遍，修院只是有文书留存的那一部分。

sources.title: Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 6 (monastic and manorial cheese)

facts.note: Maroilles 的「约 962 年」与 Munster「660 年代」常见于产区宣传，未找到一手文书；页面只写世纪。

facts.zh: 1411 年，法国国王查理六世颁发特许状，承认罗克福尔（Roquefort-sur-Soulzon）居民的权利，理由是这里「既不长一株葡萄，也不长一粒麦子」。1666 年图卢兹高等法院的判决确认了此前的王室特权，把在当地洞窟里熟成奶酪的垄断权交给罗克福尔村民。
facts.en: In 1411 Charles VI of France granted a charter protecting the people of Roquefort-sur-Soulzon, a place 'where neither vine nor wheat will grow'. In 1666 the Parlement of Toulouse confirmed the earlier royal privileges and gave the villagers a monopoly on ripening the cheese in their caves.
facts.kind: 王室特许状 + 法院判决（今 PDO 规范书引述）

sources.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOP Roquefort (version consolidée 2006), eAmbrosia

facts.zh: 帕玛森（Parmigiano Reggiano）最早的文字记录是 1254 年热那亚的一份公证文书，其中出现了「帕尔马奶酪」（caseus parmensis）。一般认为它起源于 12 世纪前后波河平原上的本笃会和熙笃会修道院。约 1350 年，薄伽丘《十日谈》（第八天第三个故事）描写了一座由帕玛森碎屑堆成的山，山上的人只管煮通心粉和饺子往下滚。
facts.en: The earliest written record of Parmigiano Reggiano is a 1254 notarial deed from Genoa that mentions 'caseus parmensis', Parma cheese. It is generally traced to Benedictine and Cistercian monasteries of the Po plain around the 12th century. Around 1350 Boccaccio's Decameron (Day 8, Story 3) imagines a mountain of grated Parmesan whose people do nothing but cook macaroni and ravioli and roll them down its slopes.

sources.title: Emilia Delizia: The Origins of Parmigiano Reggiano
Boccaccio, Decameron VIII.3 (Decameron Web, Brown University)

facts.note: 1254 文书在多处二手来源里一致，但未见文书原件影印或档案号；奶酪联合会官网历史页本次 404。

facts.zh: 常被引用的「1170 年英王亨利二世买下 10240 磅切达奶酪」并不可靠。国库卷宗（Pipe Roll）原文只记了一位林肯的 Alured 花 11 镑买了 40 wey 奶酪，没写重量，也没写「切达」；10240 磅是 1880 年萨默塞特考古学会成员按每 wey 256 磅推算出来的，而中世纪一 wey 奶酪从 180 到 416 磅不等。
facts.en: The oft-quoted claim that Henry II bought 10,240 lb of Cheddar in 1170 is shaky. The Pipe Roll itself records only that Alured of Lincoln paid £11 for 40 weys of cheese, with no weight and no mention of Cheddar. The 10,240 lb figure comes from an 1880 estimate by members of the Somerset archaeological society assuming 256 lb to the wey, when a medieval wey of cheese ranged from about 180 to 416 lb.
facts.kind: 国库卷宗（一手）+ 19 世纪推算
facts.alt: 通行说法：1170 年亨利二世以每磅一法新购入 10240 磅切达奶酪（产区与大量科普沿用）。

sources.title: r/AskHistorians answer on the 1170 Pipe Roll and Cheddar (2023), citing the Pipe Roll 17 Henry II
Cheddar village: The History of Cheddar Cheese

facts.note: AskHistorians 属二手，但引了拉丁原文「pro .xl. pensis casei」；如需上页面，最好再核 Pipe Roll Society 印本。

facts.zh: 瑞士格吕耶尔（Gruyère）地区的奶酪生产可追溯到 1115 年；这一名称在 17 世纪获得官方承认。该地与相邻的法国侏罗山区一样，靠夏季把牛群赶上高山牧场、在山上就地做大轮硬质奶酪来保存夏奶。
facts.en: Cheesemaking in the Gruyère region of Switzerland is traced to 1115, and the name gained official recognition in the 17th century. Like the neighbouring French Jura, the region kept summer milk by driving herds to high pastures and making large hard wheels on the spot.

sources.title: Interprofession du Gruyère: History

facts.note: 1115 的具体文书（常说是 Rougemont 修道院账目）官网未说明。

facts.zh: 法国侏罗山区的 Comté 产自村庄合作制奶坊 fruitière：一只奶酪轮要用约 400 升奶，单户农家的奶不够，于是各家把奶集中到一处一起做。这种合作形式已有八百多年，常见的最早文书是 13 世纪 Déservillers 与 Levier 两村的记载。
facts.en: Comté from the French Jura is made in village co-operative dairies called fruitières. One wheel takes about 400 litres of milk, more than a single farm had, so households pooled their milk. The system is more than 800 years old; the earliest documents usually cited are 13th-century records from the villages of Déservillers and Levier.
facts.num: 每轮约 380–400 升奶；今约 140–160 家 fruitière
facts.kind: 村社文书 + 产区年表

sources.title: Comté Cheese Association: 1,000 Years of Artisanal Cheesemaking (PDF)

facts.note: 1264/1267 与两村名凭记忆（产区资料常见），本次打开的 PDF 只写「八个多世纪」。

cheeses.what_zh: 生绵羊奶（Lacaune 羊）做的蓝纹奶酪，在 Combalou 山崩塌岩体中的天然洞窟里熟成至少 90 天，洞内靠岩缝 fleurines 通风，青霉 Penicillium roqueforti 长成蓝纹。
cheeses.what_en: A blue cheese of raw Lacaune ewe's milk, ripened at least 90 days in natural caves in the Combalou rockfall, ventilated by fissures called fleurines, where Penicillium roqueforti forms the veins.

cheeses.origin: 意大利艾米利亚—罗马涅（帕尔马、雷焦等地）
cheeses.what_zh: 部分脱脂生牛奶做的大轮硬质奶酪，长期熟成，质地起颗粒、带结晶。
cheeses.what_en: A large hard wheel of part-skimmed raw cow's milk, aged long until grainy and crystalline.

cheeses.what_zh: 生牛奶做的压榨熟煮硬质奶酪，坚果与咸鲜味。
cheeses.what_en: A pressed, cooked hard cheese of raw cow's milk with nutty, savoury notes.

cheeses.what_zh: fruitière 合作社用生牛奶做的大轮硬质奶酪，熟成数月到数年。
cheeses.what_en: A large hard wheel of raw cow's milk made in fruitière co-ops, aged months to years.

eras.era_zh: 近世：荷兰贸易与阿尔卑斯合作社
eras.era_en: Early modern: Dutch trade and Alpine cooperatives

facts.zh: 荷兰阿尔克马尔（Alkmaar）1365 年起已有奶酪过磅交易，当时城里只有一副奶酪秤；1593 年被视为奶酪集市正式开办之年；1612 年秤增至四副；1619 年档案里首次出现搬运奶酪的「奶酪搬运工行会」。17 世纪集市在每年五月到万圣节的周五、周六开市，18 世纪增加到每周四天。
facts.en: Cheese was weighed and traded in Alkmaar from 1365, when the town owned one pair of cheese scales. 1593 is taken as the founding year of the cheese market; the scales rose to four pairs in 1612, and the cheese porters' guild first appears in the archives in 1619. In the 17th century the market ran on Fridays and Saturdays from May to All Saints' Day, and four days a week by the 18th.
facts.kind: 城市档案（集市官方年表）

sources.title: Kaasmarkt Alkmaar: History of the Cheese Market

facts.zh: 豪达（Gouda）在 1395 年取得集市权，1668 年建成城市过磅房（Goudse Waag），奶酪按重量在此计税、成交。豪达奶酪因此以集散地而非产地得名——周边农家做的奶酪都运到这里卖。
facts.en: Gouda gained market rights in 1395 and built its weigh house, the Goudse Waag, in 1668, where cheese was weighed, taxed and sold. Gouda cheese is named after the market town rather than a farm district: farmhouse cheese from the surrounding countryside was brought there to be sold.
facts.alt: 常见说法称「豪达奶酪最早见于 1184 年文献」，未找到原件出处。

sources.title: Waag (Gouda), Wikipedia (Dutch)

facts.note: 1395 / 1668 凭通行资料，百科仅作线索；本次搜索结果里的集市综述页没给年份。

facts.zh: 荷兰在 17 世纪「黄金时代」大量出口奶酪。北荷兰的埃丹（Edam）奶酪小而硬、耐储运，适合远洋船只携带，成为海上贸易里常见的奶酪；埃丹现存的过磅房建于 1778 年。
facts.en: The Dutch exported cheese on a large scale in their 17th-century Golden Age. Edam from North Holland, small, firm and a good keeper, travelled well on long voyages and became a staple of seaborne trade; Edam's surviving weigh house dates from 1778.

sources.title: Dutch cheese markets (encyclopaedia mirror)
Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 8

facts.zh: 1612 年，帕尔马公爵拉努乔一世·法尔内塞颁令，规定了「帕尔马奶酪」的产区范围，常被视作最早的产地界定之一。
facts.en: In 1612 Duke Ranuccio I Farnese of Parma issued a decree defining the area in which Parma cheese could be made, often cited as one of the earliest legal definitions of a cheese's origin.

sources.title: Silvano Romani: Parmigiano Reggiano story

facts.note: 未打开该页核对；联合会官网历史页 404。凭通行说法。

facts.zh: 笛福在《大不列颠全岛游记》（1724–1727）中写到剑桥郡与亨廷登郡交界的斯蒂尔顿镇以奶酪闻名，称之为「我们英国的帕玛森」。斯蒂尔顿奶酪本身并不在这个镇上做，而是周边莱斯特郡等地生产、在斯蒂尔顿的驿站旅店转卖给北上南下的旅客。
facts.en: Daniel Defoe's Tour thro' the Whole Island of Great Britain (1724–27) notes that the town of Stilton is famous for cheese, 'our English Parmesan'. The cheese was not made in Stilton itself but in Leicestershire and nearby, and sold to travellers at Stilton's coaching inn on the Great North Road.

sources.title: Daniel Defoe, A Tour thro' the Whole Island of Great Britain, Letter 7 (Vision of Britain)

facts.note: 原句与信件编号凭记忆，需核文本。

facts.zh: 诺曼底卡芒贝尔（Camembert）奶酪常被说成是农妇玛丽·阿雷尔在 1791 年前后、得到一位布里地区来的流亡神父指点而发明，这是流传很广的传说，缺乏同期文献。真正让它走向全国的是 19 世纪中叶通往巴黎的铁路，以及 1890 年前后出现的杨木圆盒包装。
facts.en: Camembert is often said to have been invented around 1791 by the Normandy farm woman Marie Harel, helped by a refugee priest from Brie, a widely told legend without contemporary records. What made it national was the railway to Paris in the mid-19th century and the round poplar-wood box that appeared around 1890.
facts.alt: 说法一：玛丽·阿雷尔发明（传说）。说法二：卡芒贝尔村一带早有类似软质奶酪，阿雷尔家族只是较早做商业经营的一支。

sources.title: Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 8–9

cheeses.what_zh: 洗凝块的半硬质牛奶奶酪，年轻时奶香柔和，久存后出现焦糖味与结晶。
cheeses.what_en: A washed-curd semi-hard cow's milk cheese, mild and milky when young, caramel-like and crystalline when aged.

cheeses.what_zh: 部分脱脂牛奶做的小圆球形奶酪，质地紧实，出口版外层裹红蜡。
cheeses.what_en: A small ball of part-skimmed cow's milk cheese, firm-textured; export versions are coated in red wax.

cheeses.origin: 英格兰德比郡、莱斯特郡、诺丁汉郡
cheeses.what_zh: 牛奶蓝纹奶酪，以途经的斯蒂尔顿镇命名。
cheeses.what_en: A blue cow's milk cheese named after the coaching town where it was sold.

cheeses.what_zh: 白霉软质牛奶奶酪，成熟后中心变软流动。
cheeses.what_en: A soft, white-rinded cow's milk cheese that softens towards the centre as it ripens.

eras.era_zh: 工业化：工厂、发酵剂与凝乳酶

facts.zh: 1851 年，纽约州奥奈达县罗马镇（Rome）的农场主杰西·威廉斯开始收购邻居的牛奶、集中在一处做切达奶酪，这被视为「奶酪工厂制度」的开端。到 1860 年，纽约州的奶酪产量已占全美近一半。
facts.en: In 1851 Jesse Williams, a farmer near Rome in Oneida County, New York, began buying his neighbours' milk and making Cheddar from it in one place, the start of the cheese factory system. By 1860 New York produced almost half of America's cheese.
facts.num: 1860 年纽约州约占全美奶酪产量一半

sources.title: HMdb: Jesse Williams Historical Marker, Rome, NY (Oneida County, 1970): 'Jesse Williams in 1851 inaugurated the cheese factory system thus revolutionizing dairying.'
Encyclopedia.com: Dairy Industry (Dictionary of American History)

facts.zh: 工厂制度很快西移。1880 年美国奶酪年产量达 1.72 亿磅，增长最快的是威斯康星；1905 年威斯康星已有 1518 家奶酪厂，成为「头号奶酪州」。1890 年威斯康星大学的巴布科克发明乳脂测定法，让奶酪厂可以按奶的含脂量公平付钱给农户。
facts.en: The factory system moved west fast. US cheese output reached 172 million lb in 1880, with Wisconsin growing quickest, and by 1905 Wisconsin had 1,518 cheese factories and was the leading cheese state. In 1890 Stephen Babcock of the University of Wisconsin devised a butterfat test that let factories pay farmers fairly by the fat in their milk.

sources.title: Encyclopedia.com: Dairy Industry (Dictionary of American History)

facts.zh: 1874 年，丹麦药剂师克里斯蒂安·汉森在哥本哈根创立实验室，生产标准化的液体凝乳酶提取液（取自小牛胃），让各家奶酪厂第一次能用强度一致的凝乳酶。
facts.en: In 1874 the Danish pharmacist Christian Hansen set up a laboratory in Copenhagen to make standardised liquid rennet extract from calves' stomachs, giving cheese factories rennet of consistent strength for the first time.

sources.title: Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 9
Chr. Hansen (now Novonesis): company history

facts.note: 企业历史页未打开核对。

facts.zh: 19 世纪末，巴斯德的加热灭菌法被用到奶上：1893 年纽约的内森·施特劳斯开设牛奶站推广巴氏消毒奶，一战前已有少数城市强制执行。差不多同一时期（约 1890 年），丹麦的 Storch、德国的 Weigmann、美国的 Conn 分别分离出纯种乳酸菌发酵剂，奶酪厂开始用人工接种代替「靠天」的自然发酵。
facts.en: In the late 19th century Pasteur's heat treatment was applied to milk: from 1893 Nathan Straus ran milk stations in New York promoting pasteurised milk, and a few cities made it compulsory before the First World War. Around 1890 Storch in Denmark, Weigmann in Germany and Conn in the US isolated pure lactic starter cultures, so factories could inoculate milk instead of relying on chance souring.

sources.title: Encyclopedia.com: Dairy Industry (Dictionary of American History)
Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 9

facts.note: 发酵剂三人与 1890 年凭二手综述记忆。

facts.zh: 1911 年，瑞士图恩的 Walter Gerber 与 Fritz Stettler 把埃门塔尔奶酪加热熔化并加入柠檬酸钠，做出耐储运的熔化奶酪。1916 年 6 月 6 日，芝加哥的詹姆斯·L·卡夫获得美国专利 1,186,524「奶酪灭菌法及其产品」：把切达类奶酪边搅拌边加热到约 175°F（约 79°C）并保持一段时间，再无菌装进密封容器。
facts.en: In 1911 Walter Gerber and Fritz Stettler of Thun, Switzerland, melted Emmental with sodium citrate to make a processed cheese that kept and travelled well. On 6 June 1916 James L. Kraft of Chicago received US Patent 1,186,524, 'Process of sterilizing cheese and an improved product', which heats Cheddar-type cheese while stirring to about 175°F (79°C), holds it there, and packs it sterile into sealed containers.

sources.title: US Patent 1,186,524, J. L. Kraft, Process of sterilizing cheese and an improved product produced by such process (filed 1916-03-25, granted 1916-06-06), Google Patents
Paul S. Kindstedt, Cheese and Culture (2012), ch. 9 (Gerber & Stettler 1911)

facts.note: Gerber/Stettler 1911 一条为中等可信，专利一条已核原文。

facts.zh: 美国的工厂化也带来质量危机：1881–1896 年，由于出口了大量撇脂奶酪和掺猪油等外来脂肪的「填充奶酪」，美国在英国市场失去信誉，奶酪出口量下降了 75%。
facts.en: Factory scale brought a quality crisis too: between 1881 and 1896 American cheese exports fell by 75% after shipments of skim and 'filled' cheese, made with lard and other foreign fats, ruined its name in Britain.

sources.title: Encyclopedia.com: Dairy Industry (Dictionary of American History)

facts.note: 「掺猪油」为 filled cheese 的通行定义，原条目只写 filled。

cheeses.origin: 美国纽约州，后至威斯康星
cheeses.what_zh: 集中收奶、成批生产的切达奶酪，19 世纪美国出口英国的主力。
cheeses.what_en: Cheddar made in bulk from pooled milk, America's main cheese export to Britain in the 19th century.

cheeses.what_zh: 把成品奶酪粉碎、加乳化盐加热熔化后重新成形，灭菌、耐放、熔化时不出油。
cheeses.what_en: Finished cheese ground, heated with emulsifying salts and reshaped: sterile, long-keeping, and melting without oiling off.

facts.zh: 1933 年英国成立牛奶营销局（Milk Marketing Board），统一收购农户鲜奶。农家奶酪作坊本已在减少：一战前全英有 3500 多家，1930 年代约剩 1600 家。
facts.en: Britain set up the Milk Marketing Board in 1933 to buy farmers' milk centrally. Farmhouse cheesemaking was already shrinking: over 3,500 makers before the First World War, about 1,600 by the 1930s.

sources.title: The Courtyard Dairy: A History of British Cheese – The 20th Century and the Eradication of Farmhouse Production

facts.note: Courtyard Dairy 是专业奶酪店的长文，数字未注一手出处。

facts.zh: 二战期间英国从 1941 年起实行奶酪配给，直到 1954 年。粮食部只允许生产少数几种硬质奶酪，并对用工、出品率、缺陷和出售时的熟成期规定统一标准，统一规格的切达俗称「政府切达」（Government Cheddar）。到战争结束，仍在做奶酪的农家只剩约 100 家。
facts.en: Britain rationed cheese from 1941 until 1954. The Ministry of Food allowed only a few hard cheeses, made to fixed standards for labour, yield, defects and age at sale; the standardised Cheddar was nicknamed 'Government Cheddar'. By the end of the war barely 100 farms were still making cheese.
facts.num: 战后约 100 家农家作坊

sources.title: The Courtyard Dairy: A History of British Cheese – The 20th Century
Imperial War Museums: What you need to know about rationing in the Second World War

facts.note: IWM 页只确认奶酪属凭券配给、1954 年配给全部结束；1941 起始年来自 Courtyard Dairy。

facts.zh: 配给对地方奶酪打击最重。约克郡的温斯利代尔奶酪，1939 年有 176 家生产者，1946 年只剩 9 家，最后一家农家作坊在 1957 年停产。
facts.en: Rationing hit regional cheeses hardest. Wensleydale had 176 producers in 1939 and 9 in 1946; the last farmhouse maker stopped in 1957.

sources.title: The Courtyard Dairy: A History of British Cheese – The 20th Century

facts.zh: 美国把「未经巴氏消毒的奶做的奶酪须在不低于 35°F（约 1.7°C）下熟成至少 60 天」写进奶酪身份标准（Standard of Identity），这条规则通常追溯到 1949 年；现行的联邦法规 21 CFR 133.113（切达）仍是这样规定的。所以在美国合法销售的生乳奶酪都至少熟成两个月，生乳布里、卡芒贝尔这类短熟成软奶酪不能进口。
facts.en: US cheese standards of identity require cheese made from unpasteurised milk to be cured at no less than 35°F (about 1.7°C) for at least 60 days, a rule usually dated to 1949 and still in force, for example in 21 CFR 133.113 for Cheddar. So raw-milk cheese sold legally in the US is at least two months old, and young raw-milk soft cheeses such as raw Brie or Camembert cannot be imported.
facts.year: 1949（规则起始，通行说法）；现行 21 CFR 133

sources.title: eCFR 21 CFR 133.113 Cheddar cheese

facts.note: 条文已核；「1949」年份未找到联邦公报原件，conf 对年份为中。

cheeses.what_zh: 战时统一规格、快速出售的切达，用奶效率高、风味单一，是配给年代的「国民奶酪」。
cheeses.what_en: The standardised, quickly sold Cheddar of the ration years: efficient with milk, uniform in flavour.

cheeses.what_zh: 易碎、清爽带酸的牛奶奶酪，战时几近消失的地方奶酪代表。
cheeses.what_en: A crumbly, fresh, lactic cow's milk cheese, the emblem of the regional cheeses that nearly vanished in the war.

facts.zh: 1925 年 7 月 26 日，法国通过保护罗克福尔原产地名称的法律，罗克福尔由此成为法国第一个受法律保护的奶酪原产地名称（AOC 的前身）。2025 年产区为此办了百年庆典；2023 年从罗克福尔村洞窟运出的奶酪共 14336 吨，由 7 家奶酪商生产，出口占 28%。
facts.en: On 26 July 1925 France passed a law protecting the name Roquefort, making it the first French cheese with a legally protected designation of origin, forerunner of the AOC. The region marked the centenary in 2025; in 2023, 14,336 tonnes left the Roquefort caves, made by seven houses, with exports at 28%.

sources.title: INAO: 100 ans de l'appellation Roquefort
Cahier des charges de l'AOP Roquefort (2006), eAmbrosia
Pleinchamp: Le roquefort célèbre 100 ans d'appellation

facts.zh: 1934 年，帕尔马与雷焦一带的奶农成立帕玛森奶酪联合会，起因是廉价仿品冲击。1955 年 10 月意大利第 1269 号行政令规定，只有在产区内按规定特性生产的奶酪才能叫 Parmigiano Reggiano。2009 年产量为 2947292 只，每只约 39 公斤、用奶约 550 升，约 409 家奶酪坊参与。
facts.en: In 1934 dairy farmers around Parma and Reggio formed the Parmigiano Reggiano consortium in response to cheap imitations. Italian Executive Order No. 1269 of October 1955 reserved the name for cheese made in the area to set standards. In 2009 output was 2,947,292 wheels, each about 39 kg and taking about 550 litres of milk, from some 409 dairies.

sources.title: WIPO Magazine (2011): Parmesan – The King of Cheeses

facts.note: 产量是 2009 年数据，偏旧；需要最新数据可查联合会年报。

facts.zh: 1951 年 6 月 1 日，欧洲多国在意大利斯特雷萨签订《奶酪原产地名称与名称使用国际公约》（斯特雷萨公约），1953 年 7 月 12 日生效，承诺禁止在本国使用虚假的奶酪产地名称。公约把名称分两类：只能在原产地做的「原产地名称」，和按形状、重量、脂肪含量等特征定义、别国也可按标准生产的「典型名称」（须注明生产国）。
facts.en: On 1 June 1951 several European states signed the International Convention on the Use of Designations of Origin and Names for Cheeses at Stresa, Italy, in force from 12 July 1953, pledging to ban false cheese origins at home. It set two classes: designations of origin, which may only be made in their home region, and 'typical names' defined by shape, weight, fat content and so on, which others may make to standard if the country of production is shown.
facts.alt: 首批「原产地名称」：Pecorino Romano 联合会称只有 Pecorino Romano 与 Roquefort 两种；另有资料列为 Roquefort、Pecorino Romano、Gorgonzola、Parmigiano Reggiano 四种。

facts.en: Comté from the French Jura gained its AOC in 1958, one of the first cheeses to do so. Today about 2,500–2,700 dairy farms and 140–160 fruitière co-ops make roughly 1.5–1.7 million wheels a year.

The first list followed in Regulation 1107/96 of 12 June 1996, including Parmigiano Reggiano and Roquefort. Switzerland's Gruyère gained a national AOC in 2001 and EU recognition as an AOP in 2011.

facts.en: The North Bay is a centre of the American artisan revival. Marin French Cheese Co. in Petaluma, founded in 1865, calls itself the oldest continuously operating cheesemaker in the US; in 1979 Laura Chenel began making goat cheese commercially in Sonoma, seen as the start of American goat cheese; in 1997 Sue Conley and Peggy Smith founded Cowgirl Creamery in Point Reyes Station; and in 2000 the Giacomini family's Point Reyes Farmstead Cheese Co. launched its Original Blue.

facts.zh: 美国农业部统计：2024 年美国奶酪总产量（不含茅屋奶酪）为 142.5 亿磅，约合 646 万吨，比 2023 年增长 0.7%。威斯康星以 35.9 亿磅（25.2%，116 家工厂）居首，加州 24.8 亿磅次之。意式奶酪占 42.3%（其中马苏里拉占意式的 79.5%），美式奶酪（切达等）占 39.1%。

Wisconsin led with 3.59 billion lb (25.2%, 116 plants), followed by California with 2.48 billion lb. Italian types made up 42.3% (mozzarella 79.5% of those) and American types such as Cheddar 39.1%.

Per-capita rankings vary widely by method (France is often put at about 27 kg a year; other series rank Italy or Germany first), so no single 'champion' should be named.

facts.zh: 1990 年 3 月，美国食品药品监督管理局确认用重组大肠杆菌 K-12 生产的凝乳酶（chymosin）「一般认为安全」（GRAS），这是美国第一个通过监管的基因重组食品原料，工艺由辉瑞开发。这类「发酵生产的凝乳酶」与小牛胃里的凝乳酶分子相同；据 2012 年业内估计，美国约九成商业奶酪用的是它。
facts.en: In March 1990 the US FDA affirmed chymosin made by recombinant E. coli K-12 as generally recognised as safe, the first food substance from recombinant DNA to be regulated in the US; Pfizer developed the process. Such fermentation-produced chymosin is the same molecule as calf rennet, and a 2012 industry estimate put it in about 90% of US commercial cheese.

asia.zh: 中国古代乳制品的几个基本字：「酪」大致是发酵变稠的奶（近似酸奶或凝乳），东汉《说文解字》已收；「酥」是从奶里提出的油脂，近似黄油；「醍醐」原是汉代的词，在佛经汉译里固定为从酥中再提炼出的精油，近似澄清黄油。《汉书》说西北游牧民族「食肉饮酪」。
asia.en: The basic Chinese dairy words: lao (酪), thickened fermented milk close to yoghurt or curd, already defined in the Shuowen jiezi (c. AD 100); su (酥), the fat taken from milk, close to butter; and tihu (醍醐), a Han-era word that in Buddhist translation came to mean the oil refined from su, close to clarified butter. The Han shu says the northwestern nomads 'eat meat and drink lao'.
asia.kind: 字书 + 史书 + 佛典

sources.title: Jeffrey Kotyk, Milk, Yogurt and Butter in Medieval East Asia: Dairy Products from China to Japan in Medicine and Buddhism, Religions 12(5):302 (2021)

asia.zh: 北魏贾思勰《齐民要术》（约 533–544 年）卷六《养羊》专门记录乳品做法：作酪法、作干酪法、作漉酪法、作马酪酵法、抨酥法。其中「干酪」是把酪在太阳下晒出表皮、反复撇取、炒后捏成梨大的团再晒干，「得经数年不坏，以供远行」，是中国古书里最接近硬质奶酪的记载。
asia.en: Jia Sixie's Qimin yaoshu (c. 533–544, Northern Wei), Book 6, 'Raising Sheep', sets out dairy methods: making lao, dried lao, strained lao, a mare's-milk starter, and churning su. The 'dried lao' is skimmed repeatedly as a skin forms in the sun, stir-fried, shaped into balls the size of a pear and dried again, so that it 'keeps for years without spoiling, for long journeys', the closest thing to a hard cheese in early Chinese texts.

asia.zh: 北魏《洛阳伽蓝记》（547 年）记：南朝降将王肃初到北方吃不惯羊肉酪浆，后来被问起茶与酪孰优，答「茗不中，与酪作奴」，此后茶在北魏有了「酪奴」的戏称，可见酪是当时北方上层的日常饮食。
asia.en: The Record of Buddhist Monasteries in Luoyang (547) tells how Wang Su, a southern defector, at first could not stomach mutton and lao in the north, and later quipped that tea was not fit even to be lao's slave, so tea was nicknamed 'lao's slave' at the Northern Wei court, a sign that lao was everyday fare among the northern elite.

asia.zh: 佛经《大般涅槃经》以乳制品五个阶段作比喻：「从牛出乳，从乳出酪，从酪出生酥，从生酥出熟酥，从熟酥出醍醐，醍醐最上。」成语「醍醐灌顶」由此而来，常引唐代顾况《行路难》「岂知灌顶有醍醐，能使清凉头不热」。唐初《新修本草》（659 年）说醍醐是从酥中提取的油，一石好酥只得三四升。
asia.en: The Mahaparinirvana Sutra uses five stages of dairy as a parable: from the cow comes milk, from milk lao, from lao raw su, from raw su cooked su, and from cooked su tihu, 'tihu is the finest'. The idiom 'tihu poured on the crown' (sudden enlightenment) comes from this, often cited from Gu Kuang's Tang poem 'Hard Travelling'. The Xinxiu bencao (659) describes tihu as oil drawn from su, three or four sheng from a whole shi of good su.

asia.alt: 「醍醐灌顶」出处另有一说指敦煌变文《维摩诘经讲经文》。

asia.zh: 唐代宫廷和城市里乳制品很常见：有用酥堆成小山、冷冻后装饰的甜点「酥山」，有加果品炖煮的乳饮，还有加乳的饼和面食。唐太宗据说用牛奶煮荜茇治病，可见乳品在唐代也常当作药物。
asia.en: Dairy was common at the Tang court and in its cities: su-shan, a chilled dessert of su piled into a little mountain, milk stewed with fruit, and breads and noodles made with milk. Emperor Taizong is said to have taken milk boiled with long pepper as a remedy, showing dairy was also treated as medicine.

asia.zh: 清代宫廷有自己的奶牛群；张家口一带 1600 多户牧户为朝廷放养约一万只羊、2400 头牛，每年向京城交约 8000 公斤乳制品。晚清北京街头小贩把奶加糖熬浓、冷却后挑担叫卖「酪」，这是北京甜奶酪的前身。
asia.en: The Qing palace kept its own dairy herd, and more than 1,600 herding households near Zhangjiakou tended about 10,000 sheep and 2,400 cattle for the court, sending about 8,000 kg of dairy goods to the capital each year. In late-Qing Beijing, street vendors boiled milk down with sugar and sold it chilled from shoulder-pole vats as lao, the forerunner of Beijing's sweet milk custard.

asia.zh: 云南有两种中国少见的「真奶酪」：大理洱源县邓川一带白族的乳扇，用加热的酸木瓜水把牛奶点成凝块，拉成薄片缠在竹竿上晾两三天；石林（旧称路南）撒尼人和大理一带的乳饼，多用山羊奶，压成方块，常油煎后蘸椒盐或糖吃。明代《南诏野史》中「酥花乳线浮杯绿」一句常被引作乳扇的早期记载，有人据此推测乳扇元代已有。
asia.en: Yunnan has two of China's few true cheeses. Rushan ('milk fans') of the Bai around Dengchuan in Eryuan county, Dali, is milk curdled with hot sour-papaya water, stretched into sheets on bamboo poles and dried for two or three days. Rubing, made by the Sani of Shilin (formerly Lunan) and around Dali, is usually goat's milk pressed into blocks and often pan-fried. A line in the Ming-dynasty Nanzhao yeshi is often cited as an early mention of rushan, leading some to date it to the Yuan.

asia.zh: 蒙古族的「白食」（查干伊德）以奶为原料：奶皮子（蒙古语 öröm，ᠥᠷᠦᠮ）是把奶慢火熬煮、晾凉后结在表面的厚脂皮；奶豆腐是把发酸的奶（常是撇过奶皮或提过黄油后的酸奶）加热，使凝块析出、压模成块，晾干后可存很久；彻底晒硬的奶干（aaruul）便于牧民随身携带。
asia.en: Mongolian 'white foods' (tsagaan idee) are built on milk. Öröm (milk skin) is the thick fatty skin that forms on milk simmered slowly and left to cool; milk tofu is soured milk, often left after skimming or butter-making, heated until the curd separates and pressed into blocks that keep for a long time once dried; fully sun-hardened aaruul is easy for herders to carry.
asia.alt: 奶豆腐的蒙古语名称各地不一：常见 hurud / khuruud（胡乳达）与 bislag / byaslag（毕希拉格，ᠪᠢᠰᠢᠯᠠᠭ）两种叫法，有的地方二者指不同工艺（酸凝 vs. 加酸奶点制）。

asia.zh: 藏族的曲拉（藏语 ཕྱུར་བ，phyur ba / chura）是打酥油后剩下的脱脂酪乳加热凝结、晒干的碎粒干酪，可直接嚼食、拌糌粑或泡茶；喜马拉雅一带用牦牛奶晒干熏硬的 chhurpi 硬度极高，能含在嘴里几个小时。
asia.en: Tibetan chura (phyur ba) is made from the buttermilk left after churning butter, heated until it curdles and then sun-dried into crumbly bits, eaten as is, mixed into tsampa or dropped into tea. In the Himalaya, hard chhurpi, dried and smoked from yak milk, is so hard it can be sucked for hours.

asia.zh: 日本古代的「蘇」是把牛奶小火熬煮浓缩到约十分之一而成的乳制品。孝德天皇（645–654 在位）时有渡来人献乳；《续日本纪》记文武天皇四年（700 年）遣使造蘇；平安时代《延喜式》（927 年）规定各国轮流向朝廷「贡蘇」，并写明「牛乳一斗煎得蘇一升」，由典药寮下的乳户管理，主要当作药物。1987 年奈良国立文化财研究所飞鸟资料馆照文献复原了蘇。
asia.en: Ancient Japan's so was milk simmered down to about a tenth of its volume. Milk was presented to Emperor Kōtoku (r. 645–654) by an immigrant; the Shoku Nihongi records that in 700 Emperor Monmu sent officials to have so made; and the Engishiki (927) lays down a rota of provinces sending so to court, with the ratio 'one to of milk boiled down to one shō of so', managed by milk households under the Bureau of Medicine and used mainly as medicine. In 1987 the Asuka Historical Museum of the Nara research institute recreated so from the texts.

asia.zh: 印度的 paneer（压制鲜奶酪）和孟加拉的 chhena（酸凝鲜奶酪，做 rasgulla、sandesh 等甜点的原料）都是用酸把热奶点成凝块。来源有两说：一说受 16–17 世纪在孟加拉沿海定居的葡萄牙人影响，食物史家 K. T. Achaya 认为印度教本把「故意破坏」奶视为不洁，葡萄牙人的做法打破了这一禁忌，孟加拉的烟熏 Bandel 奶酪就是葡萄牙遗产；另一说认为 paneer 源于波斯—阿富汗一带，在德里苏丹国与莫卧儿时期成形，「paneer」一词即波斯语的奶酪，此外也有学者引《遮罗迦本集》等古籍认为热酸凝乳在古印度早已存在。
asia.en: India's paneer (pressed fresh cheese) and Bengal's chhena (the acid-set curd behind rasgulla and sandesh) are both made by splitting hot milk with acid. There are two accounts of their origin. One credits the Portuguese settled on the Bengal coast in the 16th–17th centuries: the food historian K. T. Achaya argued that Hindu custom held deliberately splitting milk to be impure and that Portuguese practice lifted the taboo; Bengal's smoked Bandel cheese is a Portuguese legacy. The other traces paneer to the Persian–Afghan world, shaped under the Delhi Sultanate and the Mughals, 'paneer' being the Persian word for cheese; some scholars also cite the Charaka Samhita and other early texts for heat-acid curd in ancient India.
asia.year: 16–17 世纪（葡萄牙说）；德里苏丹国—莫卧儿时期（波斯说）
asia.alt: 说法一：葡萄牙人影响（Achaya）。说法二：波斯—阿富汗传入 / 印度本土古已有之（Mathur、Kumar 等）。

asia.zh: 新疆小河墓地 3600 年前的开菲尔奶酪（见青铜时代一节）把中国境内的奶酪实物证据推到青铜时代早期；2024 年的古 DNA 研究认为，今天西藏等内陆东亚的开菲尔乳杆菌菌株可能与这条古老的发酵乳传统同源。
asia.en: The 3,600-year-old kefir cheese of Xiaohe in Xinjiang (see the Bronze Age section) puts physical cheese in China back to the early Bronze Age, and the 2024 ancient-DNA study suggests today's inland East Asian kefir bacteria, including Tibetan strains, may descend from that tradition.

regs.zh: 在欧盟，「Parmesan」不能随便用。2008 年 2 月 26 日欧洲法院在 C-132/05 案（欧委会诉德国）中驳回德国「Parmesan 已是通用名」的主张，认定它是对 PDO「Parmigiano Reggiano」的「联想性使用」（evocation），受欧盟法禁止。而在美国，联邦法规 21 CFR 133.165 直接给「Parmesan and reggiano cheese」定了标准：牛奶制、水分不超过 32%、干物质含脂不低于 32%、熟成不少于 10 个月，没有产地限制。正宗 Parmigiano Reggiano 的 PDO 规定是熟成至少 12 个月。
regs.en: In the EU 'Parmesan' is off-limits: on 26 February 2008, in Case C-132/05 (Commission v Germany), the Court of Justice rejected Germany's claim that the word had become generic and held it to be an evocation of the PDO Parmigiano Reggiano, which EU law forbids. In the US, 21 CFR 133.165 sets a standard for 'Parmesan and reggiano cheese': cow's milk, no more than 32% moisture, at least 32% fat in solids, cured at least 10 months, with no place of origin. The PDO Parmigiano Reggiano must age at least 12 months.
regs.num: 美标：≥10 个月；PDO：≥12 个月
regs.kind: 法院判决 + 联邦法规

regs.zh: 斐达（Feta）2002 年登记为希腊的欧盟 PDO，须用希腊本土和莱斯沃斯岛的绵羊奶（可掺不超过 30% 山羊奶）在盐水中熟成。德国和丹麦起诉要求撤销，2005 年 10 月 25 日欧洲法院驳回（C-465/02、C-466/02 合并案），理由之一是消费者普遍把 feta 与希腊联系在一起。2022 年 7 月 14 日，欧洲法院又在 C-159/20 案中判定丹麦允许本国企业以「feta」名义向欧盟以外出口白奶酪，违反了欧盟法。
regs.en: Feta was registered as a Greek EU PDO in 2002: brined cheese of sheep's milk, with up to 30% goat's milk, from mainland Greece and Lesbos. Germany and Denmark sued to annul it; on 25 October 2005 the Court of Justice dismissed the case (joined Cases C-465/02 and C-466/02), partly because consumers associate feta with Greece. On 14 July 2022, in Case C-159/20, the Court ruled that Denmark had broken EU law by letting Danish firms export white cheese as 'feta' to non-EU countries.

regs.zh: 在美国，「Gruyère」被法院认定为通用名。瑞士和法国的格吕耶尔行业组织申请把 GRUYERE 注册为美国产地证明商标，遭美国乳品出口委员会等反对；2023 年 3 月 3 日美国第四巡回上诉法院维持原判，认为美国消费者把 Gruyère 理解为一种奶酪类型。理由包括 FDA 的身份标准 21 CFR 133.149 为「Gruyere cheese」规定了成分却没有产地限制，以及德国、威斯康星、爱达荷等地产的「gruyere」长期在美国销售。
regs.en: In the US, 'Gruyère' has been ruled generic. Swiss and French Gruyère bodies sought a US certification mark for GRUYERE, opposed by the US Dairy Export Council and others; on 3 March 2023 the Fourth Circuit affirmed that American consumers understand Gruyère as a type of cheese. Its reasons included the FDA standard of identity for 'Gruyere cheese' (21 CFR 133.149), which sets composition but no geography, and long-standing US sales of gruyere made in Germany, Wisconsin and Idaho.

sources.title: Interprofession du Gruyère v. U.S. Dairy Export Council, No. 22-1041 (4th Cir. 2023), Justia

regs.zh: 美国俗称的「American cheese」，法定名称是「pasteurized process cheese」（巴氏杀菌加工奶酪，21 CFR 133.169）：把一种或几种奶酪粉碎混合、加热到至少 150°F 保持至少 30 秒，可加磷酸盐、柠檬酸盐等乳化盐（固形物不超过 3%）。用切达、科尔比、洗凝块或颗粒奶酪做成的，可以叫「pasteurized process American cheese」。奶酪含量更低的品类另有「process cheese food」「process cheese spread」等名称；不符合任何标准的则只能写「prepared cheese product」之类。
regs.en: What Americans call 'American cheese' is legally 'pasteurized process cheese' (21 CFR 133.169): one or more cheeses ground and mixed, heated to at least 150°F for at least 30 seconds, with emulsifying salts such as phosphates or citrates up to 3% of solids. Made from Cheddar, Colby, washed-curd or granular cheese, it may be called 'pasteurized process American cheese'. Products with less cheese have their own names, such as 'process cheese food' and 'process cheese spread', and those meeting no standard must use labels like 'prepared cheese product'.

sources.title: eCFR 21 CFR 133.169 Pasteurized process cheese

regs.note: 133.169 已核；「process cheese food 奶酪含量≥51%」（133.173）与 Kraft Singles 标「pasteurized prepared cheese product」两点凭记忆，law.cornell.edu 133.173 页权限超时未读到。

regs.zh: 美国的奶酪身份标准规定：用未经巴氏消毒的奶做的奶酪，必须在不低于 35°F 下熟成至少 60 天才能销售（如 21 CFR 133.113 切达）。所以在美国买不到合法的生乳嫩布里或生乳卡芒贝尔，只能买巴氏奶做的版本。
regs.en: US standards of identity require cheese made from unpasteurised milk to be cured at no less than 35°F for at least 60 days before sale (for example 21 CFR 133.113, Cheddar). That is why young raw-milk Brie or Camembert cannot be sold legally in the US, only pasteurised versions.

sources.title: eCFR 21 CFR 133.113 Cheddar cheese

regs.zh: Roquefort 的 PDO 规范写明：只能用 Lacaune 品种绵羊的生全脂奶，必须在罗克福尔村 Combalou 山崩塌岩体里的天然洞窟中熟成，自制作之日起至少 90 天；洞窟靠石灰岩裂缝 fleurines 吹进的冷湿空气通风。
regs.en: The Roquefort PDO rules require raw whole milk from Lacaune ewes and ripening in natural caves in the Combalou rockfall at Roquefort-sur-Soulzon for at least 90 days from making, the caves ventilated by cool, damp air through limestone fissures called fleurines.

sources.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOP Roquefort (2006), eAmbrosia

regs.zh: 斯特雷萨公约（1951）的「典型名称」一类，允许别国按统一的形状、重量、脂肪含量等标准生产同名奶酪，但要注明生产国。这就是为什么 Camembert、Brie、Gouda、Edam 这类名字世界各地都能用，而受保护的是带产地的全名，如「Camembert de Normandie」「Brie de Meaux」「Gouda Holland」。
regs.en: The Stresa Convention's 'typical names' class lets other countries make a cheese of the same name to shared standards of shape, weight and fat, provided the country of production is shown. That is why names like Camembert, Brie, Gouda and Edam are used worldwide, while protection attaches to fuller names with a place, such as Camembert de Normandie, Brie de Meaux or Gouda Holland.

regs.en: American 'Swiss cheese' has its own federal standard (21 CFR 133.195, also 'emmentaler cheese'), which requires holes, or eyes, formed throughout the cheese.
